HOW TO USE

Move: W A S D or arrow keys (Shift = faster). On phones, use your left thumb to walk and drag on the right to look around.

Click / tap: the door to walk in, a game to see its cover, a shelf sign to change its system, the shopkeeper to get a tip.

Cog: shelves, covers, poster · Eye: free view (Esc to exit)

Left thumb: walk · Right side: look · Tap a box to inspect

Settings

Configure your shelves, covers and poster

Shelves

Media folder

Pick a folder with system sub-folders like megadrive/, snes/, psx/. Files match by game name, and leftovers fill the rest of that shelf.

Image files

Pick individual box-art images, e.g. Sonic The Hedgehog 2 (World).png. You can also drag & drop images onto the store.

LaunchBox links

Run launchbox_covers.py to make launchbox-links.json (cover links, no image files), then load it here.

Works with art from Skraper, ES-DE, ROCKNIX, Batocera and more. Marquees, wheels and screenshots are skipped. Get art at screenscraper.fr.

Roll-up poster

Pick any image for the roll-up stand. Tall artwork fits best (about 85 × 200, portrait); other shapes are cropped to fill.

Changes apply immediately.
